# NFL Daily — 2026-10-19 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out for the rest of the season after doctors found multiple blood clots in his lungs; recovery is expected to take about three months. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50218378/eagles-jalen-hurts-season-due-blood-clots-lungs)
- Colts fired GM Chris Ballard after 10 seasons, a day after a home loss to the Titans. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50218030/colts-fire-gm-chris-ballard-home-loss-titans)
- Rams WR Davante Adams is out 6-10 weeks with a ruptured hamstring, part of a rash of injuries that also cost L.A. DT Poona Ford (ruptured triceps, season) and K Blake Grupe (torn ACL). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50221426/rams-lose-star-wr-davante-adams-6-10-weeks-mcvay-says)
- Colts CB Sauce Gardner is week-to-week with a calf strain suffered in Sunday's loss to the Titans. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2112220198786723841)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is out, having missed the past two games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Ravens WR Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is questionable after leaving Sunday's loss to the Browns. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-19 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Ravens blew a double-digit lead and fell 13-10 to the Browns, who moved into first place in the AFC North as both teams sit at 4-2. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-browns-loss-lead-squandered-jakobi-lane-josh-cuevas-2026)
- Coach Jesse Minter still lists QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) as "day-to-day" and said he could "potentially" practice this week; Jackson has missed the past two games. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-lamar-jackson-ankle-still-day-day-monday-week-7-injuries-rashod-bateman-cam-jurgens-trey-hendrickson-tyler-loop-critical-misses)
- Center Cam Jurgens (concussion) has "come a long way" over the weekend, and Minter is hopeful he can play Sunday against the Bengals. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-lamar-jackson-ankle-still-day-day-monday-week-7-injuries-rashod-bateman-cam-jurgens-trey-hendrickson-tyler-loop-critical-misses)
- WR Rashod Bateman (shoulder) "came out of it OK" after leaving Sunday's loss; Minter voiced optimism he'll be fine this week. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-lamar-jackson-ankle-still-day-day-monday-week-7-injuries-rashod-bateman-cam-jurgens-trey-hendrickson-tyler-loop-critical-misses)
- Minter hasn't ruled out bringing in a new kicker to compete with Tyler Loop after another "critical" missed field goal continued to plague Baltimore's special teams. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-lamar-jackson-ankle-still-day-day-monday-week-7-injuries-rashod-bateman-cam-jurgens-trey-hendrickson-tyler-loop-critical-misses)

# Rivals — 2026-10-19 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Steelers improved to 4-2 behind Aaron Rodgers' comeback win over the Buccaneers, with DC Patrick Graham dialing up an aggressive blitz package built around Jalen Ramsey. [Post-Gazette](https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/10/19/steelers-blitz-jalen-ramsey/stories/202610190025)
- Steelers are preparing to play in Paris this weekend as civil unrest continues in France; the NFL says the game remains on as scheduled. [Post-Gazette](https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/10/18/nfl-steelers-saints-game-paris-civil-unrest-france/stories/202610180091)
- Browns rallied past the Ravens 13-10 on Deshaun Watson's fourth fourth-quarter comeback of the season, moving into first place in the AFC North at 4-2. [Mary Kay Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2112210725032837577)
- Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson was suspended one game for spitting at Raiders TE Brock Bowers during Sunday's game. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50220546/nfl-suspends-cj-gardner-johnson-one-game-spitting)
- Chiefs remained unbeaten, routing the Chargers 22-6 to drop LA to 0-6. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/los-angeles-chargers-jim-harbaugh-chiefs-loss)
